cards.t: Invalid tool_use name (>200 chars) persisted to transcript poisons the session with 400 on every later request
cards.sum: A tool_use name over 200 characters gets saved to the transcript, and every later request and resume then fails with a 400 error.
cards.why: 2.1.281 (2026-09-23): Fixed conversations getting permanently stuck on "tool_use.name: String should have at most 200 characters" after the model called a tool by an overlong name

cards.t: VS Code: claude-vscode.toggleDictation toggles dictation in every Claude tab of the window, not the active one
cards.sum: VS Code claude-vscode.toggleDictation command starts dictation in every Claude webview instead of only the active one.
cards.why: 2.1.319: '[VSCode] Fixed the `claude-vscode.toggleDictation` command starting dictation in every open Claude view at once; it now acts only in the view you are using, and a second press stops it'

cards.t: [BUG] Opus 5.5 throws cyber safeguard to even a simple prompt with nothing unsafe
cards.sum: The Opus 5.5 cyber safeguard blocks even a simple 'hello' prompt.
cards.why: #96141 '[Bug] Anthropic API Error: Opus 5.5 safeguards flagging non-cybersecurity work' (opened 2026-09-22, 5 upvotes). This issue already carries the duplicate label.

cards.t: [Bug] /clear carries session name over to new conversation
cards.sum: Running /clear in a named session carries the display name over to the new conversation, so /resume lists several unrelated conversations under one name.
cards.why: #61172 '[BUG] /clear inherits previous session name instead of resetting it, causing duplicate-named sessions in /resume' (31 upvotes, still open). Note that 2.1.111 'Fixed /clear dropping the...

cards.t: [BUG] claude degenerates Terminals to useless tools
cards.sum: In gnome-terminal, Claude Code's mouse capture blocks native selection, double-click word select, the right-click context menu and middle-click URL opening.
cards.why: Open #62699 (80 upvotes): 'Text cannot be copied from Claude Code's output using Ctrl+Shift+C or right-click context menu' (Linux); also #66056 'mouse reporting captures right-click'. Changelog...

cards.t: [BUG] device_bash / Cowork local device bridge fails on Windows 10 (10.0.19045) — same symptom as #94266/#92958, but NOT Windows 11
cards.sum: Cowork device_bash fails on Windows 10 with Plan9 share mount errors, while the error message blames a Windows 11 update.
cards.why: #93071: 'Cowork Windows 10 22H2 x64: sandbox-helper: no Plan9 drive shares mounted - device_bash dead since 2026-09-08'. A commenter reports Windows update KB5129236 fixed it.

cards.t: Auto mode blocks actions the owner explicitly ordered on their own machine and files
cards.sum: The auto mode classifier denies deploy steps and settings edits the owner explicitly approved in chat and in CLAUDE.md.
cards.why: #97942 'Auto mode classifier denial cannot be overridden by the owner's explicit in-chat consent (no approval prompt)'; see also #98478.

cards.t: Gmail MCP: attachments over ~5MB fail due to base64 serialization in JSON parameter
cards.sum: The Gmail connector's send_message needs attachments as base64 inside tool parameters, so files over about 5MB can't be sent.
cards.why: Open #95688 'Gmail connector can't attach local files without sending base64 through the tool call' (opened 2026-09-20, 5 upvotes) reports the same limitation.

cards.t: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Overly aggressive security filtering blocks legitimate defensive code review requests
cards.sum: API safety filter blocked a defensive security review of the user's own code (with exploit examples requested) in the VS Code extension.
cards.why: #96099 'Overly aggressive safety filtering blocks legitimate code review' is an open report of the same API-side cyber classifier false positive; many similar reports exist.

cards.t: Manual permission mode: file edits via Bash (python/sed) bypass per-edit diff review
cards.sum: In manual permission mode, the model edits many files via a Bash python/sed script, skipping per-file diff review; Bash allowlist rules can remove the prompt entirely.
cards.why: #81667 '[BUG] Claude editing files via shell redirection when manual permission mode is enabled' (older, open). Partly mitigated by 2.1.269: 'Added a diff of the files a Bash command changed to the...

cards.t: [MODEL] Claude verbose code comments by default — ignores instructions to stop.
cards.sum: Claude writes verbose, redundant or chat-narrating code comments by default and ignores CLAUDE.md and memory instructions to stop.
cards.why: 256 upvotes; many users confirm it across Opus 4.8, 5, 5.5 and Sonnet. No changelog fix for comment verbosity.

cards.t: [BUG] macOS: main process pins one core at 100% while a wired Xbox controller is attached (Chromium XboxDataFetcher IOKit retry loop)
cards.sum: On macOS, the desktop app's main process pins one core at 100% while a wired Xbox controller is attached, because of Chromium's gamepad polling retry loop.
cards.why: Deterministic repro with a sample trace pointing at XboxDataFetcher. Workaround: unplug the controller or use Bluetooth. No changelog fix.

cards.t: [BUG] Code block copy adds trailing newline causing >> in PowerShell
cards.sum: The VS Code extension's code-block copy button adds a trailing newline, which leaves PowerShell at a >> continuation prompt.
cards.why: A comment traces the extra newline to the markdown renderer and suggests a one-line fix. The earlier report #60823 was closed as stale. No changelog fix.

cards.t: /resume picker: list wraps to top before the next lazy batch loads; search misses unloaded sessions; SDK/plugin sessions dominate the scan
cards.sum: The /resume picker wraps to the top before the next lazy batch loads, search misses sessions not yet loaded, and hidden SDK sessions are read on every page, making it slow.
cards.why: Same symptom as #73089 'In-session /resume picker capped at 50 most-recent sessions: scroll wraps to top, search misses older sessions', which the stale bot closed NOT_PLANNED. Still confirmed on...

cards.t: Plugin directory Validate blocks every mod Client with MOD_IMPORT_DYNAMIC_COMPUTED, even the documented form
cards.sum: The plugin directory portal's Validate wrongly blocks any mod Client with a literal module path (MOD_IMPORT_DYNAMIC_COMPUTED), while `claude plugin validate` passes it.
cards.why: Minimal repro branches are provided and it still reproduced on 2026-10-24 with 2.1.309. No changelog fix found.

cards.t: [BUG] Desktop (Linux): a view goes blank and never recovers once terminal tabs exceed Chromium's WebGL context limit
cards.sum: In the Linux desktop Code tab, each terminal tab uses its own WebGL context; past about 16 tabs Chromium drops the oldest and that view stays blank until the app restarts.
cards.why: Clear repro with log lines. No changelog fix for WebGL context loss.

cards.t: Remote control: permission prompts not rendering on mobile app
cards.sum: Permission and approval prompts never reach Remote Control clients (mobile, web, desktop), so sessions look hung until approved on the host.
cards.why: Still reproduces on 2.1.299 and 2.1.310 per recent comments, including Bash and teammate prompts. No changelog fix. Oldest issue for this symptom (newer one: #92145).

cards.t: [BUG] Claude in Chrome 1.0.94: side panel shows "Can't reach the Claude extension." in Vivaldi; classic side panel opt-out removed
cards.sum: Claude in Chrome 1.0.94+ side panel shows 'Can't reach the Claude extension' in Vivaldi/Brave because of the sender.tab check, and the classic-panel opt-out was removed.
cards.why: Root cause found in a comment: the Si() check requires sender.tab === undefined, and Vivaldi hosts side panels as tabs. A comment confirms it is still broken on 1.0.98, and a community patch works.

cards.t: Browser pane can't grant local-network/loopback permission, so Duo Desktop device-health check fails (Duo-protected SSO sites unusable)
cards.sum: The desktop Browser pane gives no way to allow local-network or loopback access, so Duo Desktop and Okta FastPass device checks fail and SSO sites can't be used.
cards.why: #99047 (Okta FastPass) was closed as a duplicate, apparently of this issue. A 2026-11-04 comment says the new per-site Local network access setting is on but the request filter still blocks loopback...

cards.t: [FEATURE] Support JSONC format for settings files (settings.jsonc)
cards.sum: Request to support JSONC (comments, trailing commas) in Claude Code settings files.
cards.why: 114 upvotes. Several duplicates (#83190, #29370) were closed into it. No changelog entry adds JSONC.

cards.t: [FEATURE] VS Code extension: Stream bash command output in real-time
cards.sum: A request to stream Bash command output live in the VS Code extension's graphical panel instead of showing it only after the command finishes.
cards.why: 93 upvotes. No VS Code changelog line adds live Bash output streaming. The CLI equivalent was #2221.

cards.t: [FEATURE] Desktop dictation: revise the live transcript while speaking instead of correcting only on Enter
cards.sum: Request for desktop dictation to keep revising the live transcript while the user speaks, instead of correcting only on Enter.
cards.why: Design enhancement; related bug #95510.

cards.t: [FEATURE] Supported persistence of a never-used headless session before its first prompt
cards.sum: Request for a supported way to persist a never-prompted headless stream-JSON session so the same session ID can be resumed after the process exits.
cards.why: Reporter says plainly this is a capability request and not a claim that documented behavior is broken. No changelog line adds empty-session persistence.

cards.t: [Feature Request] Add message inbox to filter important messages in automode conversations
cards.sum: Request for an 'inbox' view that collects the important messages addressed to the user during long auto-mode sessions.
cards.why: New UI capability request.

cards.t: [FEATURE] Allow setting plan naming scheme per-repo
cards.sum: Asks for a configurable per-repo naming scheme for plan files; plan location is already configurable.
cards.why: Staff note: plansDirectory shipped in 2.1.9 and the issue stays open for naming. 2.1.111 made plan names come from the prompt, but the naming is still not configurable.

cards.t: no repository found [GitHub integration]
cards.sum: GitHub integration page says no repository was found even though the GitHub app is installed; the report has only screenshots and no details.
cards.why: Body is just screenshots and '.'; many near-identical '[GitHub integration]' reports (#99987, #99944) were closed NOT_PLANNED with needs-info.

cards.t: [BUG]  MCP: Got new credentials, but newrelic rejected them on reconnect. Try re-authenticating, or restart Claude
cards.sum: Authenticating to the New Relic MCP server fails with 'Got new credentials, but newrelic rejected them on reconnect'.
cards.why: No logs, no last working version, and the error may come from the New Relic server. Similar earlier report #56208 ('Got new credentials, but reconnecting failed') was closed as a duplicate. No...

cards.t: "Create PR" button missing in Claude Code web UI after push
cards.sum: On iOS/web, the Create PR button area is empty after Claude pushes a branch.
cards.why: Last activity was March 2026, and the cloud Create PR flow has changed many times since (e.g. 2.1.281, 2.1.318).

cards.t: Image Upload Exceeds Size Limit Causing Persistent API Request Failure
cards.sum: An oversized image in the context makes every later request, including /compact, fail with an API 400 image-dimension error.
cards.why: Main issue for many duplicates closed in April - May 2026. Related fixes include 2.1.42 'Fixed image dimension limit errors to suggest /compact' and 2.1.287 scaling >8000px images. No comments since...

cards.t: Claude Code Memory Leak - Process Grows to 120+ GB RAM and Gets OOM Killed
cards.sum: On Linux, the Claude Code process memory grew to more than 120 GB during long sessions until the OOM killer stopped it (reported on 1.0.53).
cards.why: Many memory-leak fixes shipped after 1.0.53 (2.1.45, 2.1.50, 2.1.63, 2.1.74, 2.1.121, 2.1.243). One commenter on 2.1.215 no longer sees high memory, while newer, more specific leaks are tracked in...

cards.t: Bug: claude command not found after npm install -g on macOS with   Homebrew due to incorrect symlink
cards.sum: After `npm install -g` with Homebrew Node on macOS, the `claude` command was not found because of a broken bin symlink.
cards.why: Reported on 1.0.45 (July 2025). npm installs are no longer the recommended method and the native installer is advised (per comments). No confirmation in over 10 months; last activity Jan 2026.

cards.t: [BUG] Claude Code login fails due to phantom unpaid invoice
cards.sum: Login was refused because of a phantom unpaid invoice even though all invoices were paid; this was a backend billing/authz sync problem.
cards.why: A backend billing incident from March 2026. Staff acknowledged it and users found workarounds. It is labelled invalid.

cards.t: [Bug][cyber] False positive on repository documentation and example deployment scripts (req_011Cee4NcsVKk3TReEc7ZbFP)
cards.sum: Automated ClAudit report of a cyber safeguard false positive on a documentation and deployment-script request.
cards.why: Server-side safeguard block filed automatically by a third-party tool; already labelled duplicate, and many similar ClAudit issues were closed NOT_PLANNED.

cards.t: [Bug][cyber] Safeguard falsely flagged embedded firmware crash debugging and feature requests (req_011Cew5NS62RXEWBSbRqPKUe)
cards.sum: Auto-filed report (ClAudit tool) of a cyber safeguard false positive during embedded firmware debugging, one of a batch filed from the same session.
cards.why: Already labeled duplicate. Sibling reports #94159-#94167 come from the same session. Earlier ClAudit reports were closed NOT_PLANNED. This is a server-side safeguard, not Claude Code client code.

cards.t: Claude Account Disabled After Payment for Claude Code Max 5x Plan
cards.sum: User's account was disabled right after paying for a Max plan; many commenters report bans and refused refunds.
cards.why: Personal account bans and refunds are handled by support and trust and safety, not the Claude Code codebase. Comments are individual account cases and include personal contact details.

cards.t: [Feature Request] Improve Model Support for Scientific Research Workloads
cards.sum: Vague complaint that safeguards interrupted scientific drug-discovery work, with no details about what was blocked.
cards.why: One sentence with no repro or details. Similar requests such as #74105 were closed.

cards.t: too much security checks, my agents cant run by them self
cards.sum: Vague complaint that security checks stop agents from running on their own; no details.
cards.why: One-line body with no tool, mode or denial message.
